components.name: Provider-neutral Chat Core
components.purpose: Runs a bounded structured tool-call loop without binding the command protocol to one LLM provider

components.name: Paired Controller Client
components.purpose: Persists local controller trust state, authenticates controller sessions, signs remote commands, refreshes stale sessions, and consumes results

components.name: OpenAI-compatible Provider Adapter
components.purpose: Maps provider-neutral chat messages/tools to an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions boundary
owns: API-key header injection from runtime environment
provider response bounds and tool-call parsing

components.name: LLM Client
components.purpose: Requests typed tools and consumes streamed results

components.name: Relay Server
components.purpose: Pairs device/controller identities, authenticates short-lived sessions, validates signed command envelopes, and routes bounded queues/results

components.name: PC Agent
components.purpose: Maintains device identity and per-start session, polls outbound, verifies signed requests, obtains trusted local approvals, and delegates bounded capabilities

components.name: Identity
components.purpose: Persists device Ed25519 identity and derives deterministic device IDs and pairing codes

components.name: Command Protocol
components.purpose: Defines signed expiring command envelopes, per-start session binding, and replay checks

components.name: Policy Engine
components.purpose: Makes automatic allow approval-required or deny decisions at the user device

components.name: Local Approval Store
components.purpose: Issues one-use short-lived local approval grants bound to exact privileged requests

components.name: Local Capability Executor
components.purpose: Executes bounded filesystem process and Git operations after policy and approval authorization

components.name: Audit Logger
components.purpose: Records bounded structured security events without secret-bearing raw payloads

data_flows.meaning: assistant text or validated structured tool calls
paired controller assertion and controller-signed CommandEnvelope bound to current agent session
outbound long-poll delivery of relay-validated signed command envelope
agent re-verifies controller signature device/session freshness and replay before local policy
privileged capability requires trusted local approval
one-use exact-request approval enables privileged execution
decision and outcome metadata without raw secret-bearing payloads
validated JSON tool result returned to conversation

external_boundaries.name: Public network
external_boundaries.contract: Device traffic is outbound from the agent. Relay binds loopback by default; public deployment requires external TLS termination and remains unproven.

external_boundaries.name: Initial bootstrap
external_boundaries.contract: The shared registration bootstrap key is only for an unpaired device to create a temporary pre-pairing session; it is rejected for paired devices and is not controller command authority.

external_boundaries.name: Paired identity
external_boundaries.contract: Paired device and controller sessions require Ed25519 proof-of-possession, pairing generation, freshness, nonce replay checks, and current agent session binding.

external_boundaries.name: Local privileged execution
external_boundaries.contract: Remote payloads cannot self-approve. Privileged capability grants are local one-use short-lived exact-request bindings.

external_boundaries.name: Local secrets
external_boundaries.contract: Device private identity persists locally; POSIX permissions and symlink safety are enforced, while OS-native Windows key protection remains future hardening.

external_boundaries.name: Audit data
external_boundaries.contract: Audit schema excludes raw arguments tokens stdout stderr and free-form messages; only bounded structured metadata and digests are accepted.

external_boundaries.name: LLM provider
external_boundaries.contract: Provider API key is supplied at runtime and not persisted by max-chat. Non-loopback provider endpoints require HTTPS and default HTTP redirects are refused.
